rationale: Shanzila is building LLM-based products at ReachLLM and has TypeScript expertise, while Su has deep experience translating LLM research into production systems—including posttraining, evals, and multi-agent architectures. Su's conviction that real-world impact matters more than marginal benchmark gains, combined with their mentorship in bridging research and production ML, could directly inform ReachLLM's product direction and technical approach.
intro_message: Shanzila Ahmed, meet Su Park — Su's expertise in production LLM systems and posttraining at Turing could be valuable as you scale ReachLLM's product, and your product instincts might help Su identify gaps between cutting-edge research and what customers actually need.
